summary: New York, London, Hong Kong and Beijing are easy, Shenzhen and Hangzhou surprise, but the rich-sounding cities a player reaches for (Los Angeles, Dubai, Tokyo, Paris, Miami) all cost lives.
reasons: Builder's own replay, pending a real judge. Three casual orders found 8, 5 and 3: it depends on whether Los Angeles (#17, 40), Dubai (#30), Tokyo (#23), Paris (#14), Singapore (#12) and Miami come before the Chinese cities.

Hurun Global Rich List 2026, 32 cities deep; Forbes' 2025 top 10 on the same page agrees on 9 of them (it has Singapore and Los Angeles, not Shenzhen and Hangzhou). Cities under Hurun's cut (Miami, Monaco, Zurich, Chicago) are answers with no figure.
Like billionaire-countries (free play): a wall of famous near misses, so it is likely too punishing for Today's list.
fixes: If a judge agrees on free play, drop its `debut` flag in topics.ts, or it waits out of random play for good.
